storyCards.headline: Dominique: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Singing Nun's "Dominique" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

Dominique was released in 1963.
